# Theory: Niche is a Different Default, Not a Toy

Codeberg, Gogs, GitBucket, Phorge, GHES, and git-without-a-UI occupy corners: community ops, ancestry, JVM, review heritage, on-prem GitHub, or no web forge at all.

## Invariants

1. GHES is still GitHub lock-in, on your power bill.
2. Gogs is the ancestor story for Gitea.
3. A forge-less host (gitolite, Soft Serve) is still Git hosting.

```text
UI-heavy  GitLab … Gitea … cgit/gitolite  UI-minimal
```

## What can break

- Picking a niche forge for features it does not claim.

## How to read this chapter

Codeberg, GitBucket, Gogs, Phorge, GHES, summary table.
